evidence_status: Selected design values and analytical estimates; not as-built measurements

selected_components.battery: Bioenno BLF-1206A, manufacturer label 12 V and 6 Ah; 72 Wh conservative energy basis
selected_components.charger: Proposed BQ24650-based solar CC/CV design matched to the LiFePO4 pack; not as-built
selected_components.motor_supply: Proposed regulated 12 V rail; current limiting and undervoltage handling required

operating_assumptions.modelled_wheel_load_sharing: Equal traction among four wheels; no skid-turning loss or soft-soil sinkage included

geometry_notes.ground_clearance: The 130 mm value is a selected nominal central-chassis clearance target; it is not a uniform underbody clearance or obstacle-traversal rating. See Blender mission_reopen_verification.json for minimum modeled assembly clearances.
geometry_notes.solar_panel_hinge_height: 720 mm is the selected upper panel hinge/reference height. The modeled frame and laminate extend slightly above this point; it is not the maximum external height.
